name: recipient-realization probe (NOT a simple recipientless probe)

hypothesis.H-R: The generator's candidate rule structurally requires an explicit recipient argument instance; recipientless realizations therefore yield no candidate.
hypothesis.H0: Candidate generation does not depend on recipient realization.

conditions.R2: provider + theme + recipient in to-PP (prepositional dative)

gold_outcome_rule: R1 gold relation is YES (legitimate provision); R1 expected_candidate is CHECK (not pre-defined as FN). Item outcome absent/present only. SCHEMA-UNREALIZABLE vs TRUE SILENCE is an analysis-level verdict on the pattern, never an item label: R0/R2 present-with-recipient + R1 absent = schema-unrealizable pattern; R1 present = H-R dead; R0 failing too = uninterpretable as schema.

decision_rule.R0_8_R1_0_R2_8: specific realization matters (ditransitive vs bare), not mere recipient presence

material_shape: 8 sets x 3 conditions x YES/NO with deny = 48 sentences; recipient position is the only structural difference (R2 keeps recipient in to-PP)
